previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~6-9, w~8-12) with 1-3 COLOR-2 (red) EMITTERS on distinct rows, each placed at column c ∈ [0, w-4] (clear cells to the right). With ~65% probability per emitter, ONE COLOR-5 (gray) WALL is placed at a column to the right of the emitter (between c+2 and w-1) on the same row. Rule (RAYCAST RIGHTWARD FROM 2-EMITTERS, PAINT BEAM 7): for EACH 2-emitter at (r, c), STEP RIGHTWARD c+1, c+2, … until either a non-0 WALL (color 5 typically) or the GRID EDGE. PAINT every 0-cell along the beam with COLOR-7 (orange). The 2-emitter and any 5-wall stay. Net: red emitters spray orange beams rightward until blocked.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The row-major list of first-hit mirror records and their input-derived turn directions.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Trace rightward from each color-2 emitter to its first nonzero hit; when that hit is a color-6 or color-8 mirror, bind the hit location, mirror color, and corresponding up/down direction.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Starting beside each recorded mirror, trace through zero cells in its bound vertical direction and add those cells to the color-7 beam output.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The vertical ray origin and direction are determined by the obstacle first reached from that emitter. Skipping the first-hit binding yields the canonical stop-at-obstacle output and changes this qualified case.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical stop-at-obstacle rays plus color-6/up and color-8/down mirror turns; 2–6 demonstrations, four private queries, 30x30 stress, protected Racket labels, bounded shortcut audit, and sequential public projection are retained. A task-local bridge normalizes the legacy single-pair test container for authoring preflight only.
